title: Sinusoidal Measurement (PLL, Three-Phase)
text: Estimate three-phase sinusoidal characteristics using a phase-locked loop, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Enable moving average filter on input} sets the option to enable frequency-dependent moving average, {Enable input normalization} sets the option to enable normalization of input, {Loop filter proportional gain} sets the lF proportional gain, {Loop filter integral gain} sets the lF integral gain, {Initial frequency (Hz)} sets the initial estimate of input frequency and {Initial phase angle (rad)} sets the initial estimate of phase angle. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Enable moving average filter on input
params.values: Option to enable frequency-dependent moving average filter On (default) | Off

params.name: Enable input normalization
params.values: Option to enable normalization of input Off (default) | On

params.name: Initial frequency (Hz)
params.values: Initial estimate of input frequency 60 Hz (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial phase angle (rad)
params.values: Initial estimate of phase angle 0 rad (default) | scalar or vector
